topic: AA Amyloidosis secondary to chronic arthritis

source.title: Systemic AA amyloidosis: epidemiology, diagnosis, and management
source.whyItFits: Open review of systemic AA amyloidosis. It names rheumatoid arthritis, ankylosing spondylitis, and chronic juvenile arthritis among the inflammatory causes, and it gives the precursor protein, the Congo-red standard, SAP scintigraphy, and the proteinuria presentation.
